gloss: in all directions; every which way

definitions.gloss: in all directions; every which way
definitions.explanation: Literally 'four directions, eight directions' — meaning all around, in every direction.

examples.japanese: {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見渡|みわた}した→見渡す：07169_miwatasu⟧。
examples.english: I looked around in all directions.

examples.japanese: {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逃|に}げ{散|ち}った。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四方八方|しほうはっぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}して→回す：01158_mawasu⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: He reached out in every direction to gather information.

notes:
USAGE:
{四方八方|しほうはっぽう} is a four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) meaning all directions. It is often used adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or from ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (in all directions), {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from all directions).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{散|ち}る→散る：02075_chiru⟧ (to scatter in all directions)
- {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{攻|せ}める→攻める：02123_semeru⟧ (to attack from all sides)
- {四方八方|しほうはっぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ (to try every avenue)
